ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of low-intensity black pigmentation to high-intensity white/light-gray regions across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Right lobe contains a dominant contiguous white patch with high-density black speckling spanning from the mid-region to the distal tip. Left lobe displays sparse, non-contiguous white mottling primarily localized near the median notch and along the inner trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 65 to 75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary with pixel-amplitude fluctuations ranging from 5 to 15 pixels; serrations are most jagged on the outer halves of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curvature (bowing outwards) along the outer edges of both lobes leading to pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast clusters of roughly circular brownish-white pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, near-vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks or scratches) visible within the white pigmented region of the right lobe lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation and associated calcareous scarring concentrated on the trailing edge tips of both lobes.
